name: "Bananas Foster" Croissant French Toast with Maple Breakfast Sausages

instructions.primary_message: FOR CROISSANT FRENCH TOAST: Preheat oven to 200°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Place eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla, and spices in a large bowl; whisk to combine. Add flour and baking powder, then whisk once more until batter is smooth. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups whole milk
¼ cup granulated sugar
½ tsp vanilla extract
½ tsp salt
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
¼ tsp nutmeg, ground
1 cup all-purpose flour
2 tsp baking powder

instructions.primary_message: Preheat two large skillets over medium-high heat.
While the skillets heat up, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut croissants in half horizontally.

Once the skillets are hot, add 1 tablespoon butter to each and swirl to coat the bottoms. Working in batches, dip croissant halves in batter, allowing excess to drip back into the bowl. Divide between the skillets and cook until golden brown on both sides, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to the baking sheet and place in the oven to keep warm. (Reserve skillets for next steps.)
FOR THE SAUSAGE: Return one of the skillets to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add additional butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
butter, unsalted
12 breakfast sausage links, maple flavor

instructions.primary_message: FOR THE BANANAS FOSTER: Meanwhile, peel and cut bananas crosswise into thin slices. Roughly chop walnuts.

Return the other skillet to medium heat, add additional butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sugar, rum (if using), vanilla, and cinnamon. Whisk to combine the sauce, bring to a simmer, and cook until slightly thickened, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup butter, unsalted
⅔ cup brown sugar
3 tbsp dark rum
1 tsp vanilla extract
½ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Add bananas and walnuts to the skillet with the sauce and continue to cook, stirring gently, until bananas are slightly softened, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
TO SERVE: Divide croissants between plates; top with banana sauce and a scoop of ice cream. Serve sausages on the side and enjoy!
